entities.name: UserConsumerTV
entities.rationale: Blue hand-drawn TV/monitor on the left of the whiteboard representing Vizio smart TVs. Orange notes below it read 'Logs', 'Perf', 'User' (types of data emitted). Not inside any container box.

entities.name: Kinesis
entities.rationale: AWS_Icon_3 at (794,404), labeled 'KINESIS'. Transcript: Kinesis data streams are the front door (8-shard pipeline). Standalone, no enclosing box.

entities.name: Kinesis Firehose
entities.rationale: AWS_Icon_5 at (1020,205), labeled 'KINESIS FIREHOSE'. Takes data from Kinesis and delivers it to Redshift and S3. Standalone, no enclosing box.

entities.name: Redshift
entities.rationale: AWS_Icon_4 at (1289,210), labeled 'REDSHIFT'. Data warehouse for aggregations. Standalone, no enclosing box.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: AWS_Icon_1 at (1025,523), green bucket icon labeled 'S3'. Long-term raw data store below Firehose. Standalone, no enclosing box.

entities.name: QuickSight
entities.rationale: AWS_Icon_2 at (1294,485), labeled 'QUICKSIGHT'. Visualization using SPICE datasets loaded from Redshift. Standalone, no enclosing box.

visual_connections.description: Orange arrow from the TV to the Kinesis icon; TVs send logs, performance telemetry and user data directly to Kinesis Data Streams.
Orange arrow going up-right from Kinesis to Kinesis Firehose; stream data is piped through Firehose.
Orange arrow pointing right from Firehose to Redshift; Firehose loads data into the Redshift data warehouse.
Orange arrow pointing down from Firehose to S3; raw data is stored long-term in S3.
Orange arrow pointing down from Redshift to QuickSight; custom SQL pulls data from Redshift into SPICE datasets for visualization.
